checks.name: Eight finite algebra model families
checks.scope: All eight finite matrix, spectral, graph and hypothesis model families run without state writes or book inputs.

checks.name: Exact critical-point factor and complete oscillator coordinate change
checks.scope: Full Hamilton derivative, entire canonical matrix, normalized quadratic form and one-form coefficient difference.

checks.name: Full nilpotent exponential and all graded real block invariants
checks.scope: Whole polynomial flow and conserved matrices, same-inertia inequivalence by spectra, and exact mixed 8-dimensional ranks and characteristic polynomial.

checks.name: Actual sectorial Jordan homotopy, exact generalized projection and flow
checks.parameter_scope: Exact polynomial identities for every real u; sector/positivity samples u=0,1/3,2/3,1
checks.scope: Full 4-by-4 Hamilton matrix, nonsemisimple spectrum, changing geometric multiplicity, fixed positive generalized plane, Hermite projector and entire restricted exponential.

checks.name: Independent oriented resolvent integration through the Jordan degeneracy
checks.scope: Actual numerical resolvent quadrature compared with the independently derived exact Hermite projection; wrong-sign control fails. Not a general spectral-continuity proof.

checks.name: Exact full graph normalization, Hermitian factor and compatible metric
checks.scope: Closed radical square root, whole real canonical matrix, positive complex graph, full structure identities and every leading metric minor.

checks.name: Complex scalar numerical range, sector failures including C=0 and non-strict planes
checks.scope: Exact scalar value, genuine kernel failures, indefinite real form under the vacuous zero-sector inequality, all weak-plane pairings and full Fourier rotation; does not establish the arbitrary quotient proof.

checks.name: Pointed zero-width sector selects precisely the positive oscillator plane
checks.scope: Exact eigenvalues and both eigenspaces, exclusion of the negative imaginary eigenvalue, full rank-one projector and opposite Hermitian signs. The old whole-axis selection would have rank two and include a negative vector.

limitations: The unrestricted signature exhaustion, generalized spectral pairing, common-contour continuation, compatible-structure uniqueness and positive quotient arguments are written proofs; finite models do not certify them. Independent review remains open.
